namespace Quartz
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The jobs this assembly declares with <c>[QuartzJob]</c>, as the calls that register them.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Written by Quartz's source generator from the attributes on the job classes. Every call below
    /// is one this application could have written by hand, and means there what it means here.
    /// </remarks>
    internal static class QuartzDeclaredJobs
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Adds every job this assembly declares, and every schedule those jobs declare.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="builder">The scheduler being built.</param>
        /// <returns>The same builder, so that the call chains.</returns>
        public static global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder AddDeclaredJobs(this global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder builder)
        {
            builder.AddJob<global::App.CleanupJob>(job => job
                .WithIdentity("cleanup")
                .StoreDurably(true));

            // ReportJob belongs to the "reporting" scheduler alone.
            if (builder.SchedulerName == "reporting")
            {
                builder.AddJob<global::App.ReportJob>(job => job
                    .WithIdentity("report"));

                builder.AddTrigger<global::App.ReportJob>(trigger => trigger
                    .WithIdentity("report")
                    .ForJob("report")
                    .WithCronSchedule("0 0 6 * * ?"));
            }

            return builder;
        }
    }
